help.title: About Bookings
help.overview: A booking schedules a time window for a marketplace order with a provider — start, end, and timezone. It is the calendar attachment for service work that happens at an agreed time.

sections.title: What you set
items: Order links the booking to the service engagement.
Provider is who is expected to deliver in that window.
Start and end define the slot; timezone stores how that slot was intended to be read.
Create a booking when the order needs a concrete appointment, not only a delivery due date.

sections.title: How it sits with orders
items: Orders track money and delivery status; bookings track when people meet or work.
Open the related order for accept, start, deliver, dispute, or cancel.
Soft delete hides the booking; restore returns it.
